title: Tenant egress profile manager and share-block policies
creator: Asha Mehta
description:
Problem: Customers in regulated environments need a single, auditable surface to define outbound (egress) behavior and public sharing for their tenant. Current controls are scattered (IP allowlists, per-route flags, and a weak 'disable sharing' checkbox in Console) and lack: fine-grained profiles, RBAC integration, consistent audit entries, and SSO-enforced admin workflows.

Goal: Implement a Tenant Egress Profile Manager (TEPM) that lets org admins create named egress profiles (default, restricted, sealed) combining IP allowlists, file/export disablement, and public-sharing rules. TEPM must integrate with RBAC v2 so only authorized roles can change profiles, produce structured audit logs for every mutation and effective-policy-evaluation event, and surface a clear admin UI plus API. TEPM will also respect SSO/SAML constraints (e.g., require SSO re-auth for destructive admin changes) and be feature-flag deployable for canary rollout.
acceptance_criteria: API: POST /v2/orgs/{org_id}/egress_profiles returns 201 and records an audit event with fields [actor, actor_role, target_org, profile_id, diff, request_id, ip, timestamp]
API: GET /v2/orgs/{org_id}/effective_egress returns evaluated policy for given request context (user, route, source_ip) matching Console preview
RBAC: Only principals with permission 'egress.manage' or role 'org-admin' can create/update/delete egress profiles; attempts without permission return 403 and generate an audit event
Console: New Egress Profiles page where org admins can create named profiles, toggle 'disable public sharing', manage IP allowlist CIDRs, and set 'export-mode' (allowed | quarantine | disabled)
SSO: For orgs with SAML enforced, destructive profile changes (delete, set export-mode=disabled) require SSO re-auth or second-factor confirmation in Console
Audit logs: All profile CRUD and evaluation events are emitted to internal audit pipeline and to the org's configured audit export (syslog/S3) with stable schema v1.1
Migration: Existing global 'disable public sharing' checkbox and IP allowlist are migrated to a default egress profile for each org without changing applied behavior
Telemetry: Dashboards show per-org profile usage, number of blocked export attempts, and top blocked destinations by CIDR within 24h of rollout
Tests: Unit, integration, and E2E tests cover RBAC enforcement, audit event content, SSO gating path, and API contract.
notes: Design trade-off: store profiles as immutable revisions to improve auditability vs. in-place edits for simplicity. We chose revisioned objects (append-only) with a pointer to 'active_profile_id' to ease rollback and simplify diff audit entries.

Implementation approach: backend service 'egress-control' will own evaluation, storage, and audit emission. Console reads/writes through existing org-config API surface which will be extended. Feature flag 'tepm.v1' gates the Console and API routes.
RBAC mapping: integrate with RBAC v2 permission model. Add new permission slug 'egress.manage' and map to existing role templates in Admin Settings (org-admin -> true, billing -> false).
SSO enforcement: reuse SAML session validation endpoint. For destructive changes enforce max_session_age < 5 minutes or call SSO reauth flow. Document this in Admin UX copy to avoid confusion.
Backward compatibility: keep old IP allowlist validation endpoint for 3 months after migration and return a deprecation header encouraging use of profiles.
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (API + storage): create egress-profile resource, revision model, and migrations from existing org settings
Phase 2 (RBAC + Audit): add egress.manage permission, emit structured audit events (schema v1.1), integrate with audit export pipeline
Phase 3 (Console + SSO UX): Console editor for profiles, SSO reauth gating, preview effective policy for sample request
Phase 4 (Rollout + Telemetry): feature-flag canary, monitor blocked-export metrics and support-runbook testing
Phase 5 (Cleanup): deprecate legacy endpoints, add documentation and runbooks
qa_plan: Unit tests for policy evaluation engine with edge cases: overlapping CIDRs, default-deny, wildcard subnet notation
Integration tests for audit emission verifying schema fields and that events reach export sinks
RBAC matrix tests: verify CRUD allowed/denied for role permutations including custom roles
E2E Console test: create profile, set as active, attempt blocked export via API and validate result and audit entry
Chaos test: simulate database failover and ensure evaluation falls back to cached last-known-active profile (read-only) to preserve safety
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Misconfigured allowlist can block legitimate traffic and break jobs. Mitigation: provide dry-run mode and 'preview sample requests' in UI, and automatic rollback if blocked-export rate spikes > 20% in first 2h of activation.
Risk: Audit volume spike. Mitigation: batch audit events to export pipeline and support sampling for low-risk evaluation events while always emitting full audit for mutation events.
Risk: RBAC migration mismatch. Mitigation: add admin migration tool that simulates permission grants before applying and notify affected principals via email/console banner.
Risk: SSO reauth poor UX. Mitigation: visible CTA explaining why reauth is required plus one-click SSO flow and fallbacks for service accounts via 'delegated_admin' token path.
